source.title: <NYI> <TXT> Stormwind Commendation
source.description:
If you earn a commendation from one of our Marshals, then bring it to me.  It will be good for one of our Lion Emblem gloves.

        See if you've already completed this by typing:

        /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(137))
